bridge-type.label: Volvo Cars Account
bridge-type.description: Volvo ID account accessed through an application registered on the Volvo Cars developer portal

parameter.name: clientId
parameter.label: Client ID
parameter.description: Client ID of the application registered on the Volvo Cars developer portal.

parameter.name: clientSecret
parameter.label: Client Secret
parameter.description: Client secret of the application registered on the Volvo Cars developer portal.

parameter.name: apiKey
parameter.label: API Key
parameter.description: VCC API key of the application, sent as vcc-api-key header with every request.

parameter.name: redirectUri
parameter.label: Redirect URI
parameter.description: Redirect URI exactly as registered for the application, e.g. http://openhab:8080/volvocars.

parameter.name: scopes
parameter.label: Scopes
parameter.description: Space separated list of OAuth scopes to request. Leave empty to request all scopes supported by the binding. Only request scopes that are enabled for the application.

thing-type.label: Volvo Vehicle
thing-type.description: A vehicle connected to the Volvo ID account

parameter.name: vin
parameter.label: VIN
parameter.description: Vehicle Identification Number of the vehicle.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Interval in minutes to refresh doors, windows, engine, fuel, battery, trip and location data.

parameter.name: slowRefreshInterval
parameter.label: Maintenance Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Interval in minutes to refresh rarely changing maintenance data like service and warning information. Must not be shorter than the refresh interval.

parameter.name: engineRunTime
parameter.label: Engine Run Time
parameter.description: Duration in minutes the engine keeps running after a remote start.
